mentions.name: Marches & Gnats
mentions.description: A programming puzzle game similar to Advent of Code where players solve challenges by programming a Turing machine. It offers 13+ quests ranging from arithmetic basics to Elementary Cellular Automata and Sudoku, with a Turing machine core rewritten in Rust for faster evaluation of heavier tasks. The game is competitive, rewarding efficient solutions, with 102 players having joined and submitted 15,000 solutions, plus a storyline whose outlines are drafted with ChatGPT and mechanics balanced against rule-exploiting loopholes.
mentions.source_excerpt: In June, I shared Marches & Gnats (https://mng.quest), a programming puzzle game (similar to Advent of Code) where you solve challenges using a Turing machine.
